critiques.subject: Black-and-white close-up portrait of a fluffy white dog (Samoyed-type) looking at the camera
critiques.mood: Warm, gentle, and slightly nostalgic due to the monochrome treatment and soft background blur
improvements: [MODERATE] Reduce global highlights/whites (e.g., Highlights -20 to -40, Whites -10 to -25) and add a touch of midtone contrast to recover fur texture without losing the bright, airy look
[MODERATE] Apply selective sharpening to the eyes/nose (masking or brush: Texture +10 to +20, Clarity +5 to +10, Sharpening +20 to +40) while avoiding the fur edges and background
[MODERATE] Denoise with a balance that preserves fur detail (LR Denoise/AI or Luminance NR ~15–30; add a small amount of grain if needed to keep the B&W aesthetic consistent)

[SUBTLE] Subtle background burn and edge vignette (Radial/linear gradient: Exposure -0.2 to -0.5 around frame; keep subject face untouched) and consider a slight crop to reduce empty space above the ears
preserve: Black-and-white treatment and soft background bokeh
Natural, friendly expression and overall gentle tonality
critiques.notes: Strong, charming dog portrait with pleasing bokeh and a classic monochrome look. Main opportunities are recovering highlight detail in the fur, improving eye/nose crispness, and managing noise while keeping the soft, nostalgic aesthetic.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce global highlights/whites (e.g., Highlights -20 to -40, Whites -10 to -25) and add a touch of midtone contrast to recover fur texture without losing the bright, airy look
improvements_detailed.reason: The white fur is close to clipping in places, which flattens detail; controlled highlights will bring back separation in the coat.

improvements_detailed.action: Apply selective sharpening to the eyes/nose (masking or brush: Texture +10 to +20, Clarity +5 to +10, Sharpening +20 to +40) while avoiding the fur edges and background
improvements_detailed.reason: The portrait reads strongest when the eyes and nose are crisp; targeted sharpening improves perceived focus without emphasizing noise in the fur.

improvements_detailed.action: Denoise with a balance that preserves fur detail (LR Denoise/AI or Luminance NR ~15–30; add a small amount of grain if needed to keep the B&W aesthetic consistent)
improvements_detailed.reason: Visible noise/grain in midtones and shadows competes with fine coat texture; controlled reduction improves clarity while maintaining the intended monochrome feel.

improvements_detailed.action: Subtle background burn and edge vignette (Radial/linear gradient: Exposure -0.2 to -0.5 around frame; keep subject face untouched) and consider a slight crop to reduce empty space above the ears
improvements_detailed.reason: Darkening distractions and tightening composition keeps attention on the dog's face and expression.

critiques.subject: Black-and-white close-up portrait of a fluffy white dog (Samoyed-type) against a blurred outdoor background
improvements: [MODERATE] Recover highlight detail in the fur by lowering Highlights (~-30 to -50) and Whites (~-10 to -25), then use a gentle tone curve to keep contrast without clipping

[SUBTLE] Dodge and burn for shape: slightly lift midtone shadows in the eyes and under the brow (+0.2 to +0.4 EV) and burn the outer fur edges/background a bit (-0.2 to -0.5 EV)
[SUBTLE] Refine composition with a small crop to reduce empty space at the bottom/left and better center the dog’s face; keep ears fully in frame
preserve: Black-and-white treatment and overall soft, gentle contrast
Smooth background blur (bokeh) that isolates the subject
critiques.notes: Strong, appealing B&W pet portrait with pleasing bokeh and expression. The main limitation is slightly hot highlights in the white fur and a touch of softness in the facial details; targeted highlight recovery and selective sharpening/dodging will improve texture and impact without changing the intended soft look.

improvements_detailed.action: Recover highlight detail in the fur by lowering Highlights (~-30 to -50) and Whites (~-10 to -25), then use a gentle tone curve to keep contrast without clipping
improvements_detailed.reason: The bright coat is close to clipping in places; recovering highlights restores texture and separation in the fur while keeping the high-key look.

improvements_detailed.action: Add selective micro-contrast to the face: apply a radial mask over the eyes/muzzle and increase Texture/Clarity slightly (+10 to +20), with a small Sharpening boost; avoid pushing fur too hard
improvements_detailed.reason: The image reads a touch soft; targeted detail makes the eyes and nose feel crisper and more engaging without making the coat gritty.

improvements_detailed.action: Dodge and burn for shape: slightly lift midtone shadows in the eyes and under the brow (+0.2 to +0.4 EV) and burn the outer fur edges/background a bit (-0.2 to -0.5 EV)
improvements_detailed.reason: Improves facial dimensionality and draws attention to the expression while maintaining the soft, moody background.

improvements_detailed.action: Refine composition with a small crop to reduce empty space at the bottom/left and better center the dog’s face; keep ears fully in frame
improvements_detailed.reason: Tightening the frame increases subject presence and reduces the weight of darker negative space.
